description:
[Reports] Run a saved custom report and return each block's rows (aggregated numbers, at most 500 rows per block). Optional `filters` JSON overrides the period / positions / interviews for this run only. Report numbers are decision-support material for a human reviewer.

Runs every block of a saved report and returns its rows. Filters start from the report's defaults, then your own saved filters, then `filters` if you pass it. Each block runs on its own: a block that fails returns ok=false with an error while the others still return data. Numbers are aggregated; no block returns more than 500 rows.

conversation_id.description: Pass the exact conversation_id from the server's previous response, unchanged. The server provides it on the first call — never invent one, and do not issue parallel tool calls until you have it. Keep passing the same conversation_id for the rest of the conversation, including after later user messages or on a different task; do not reset it when the user starts a new request.

draft.description: Run the unpublished draft instead (only if you can edit the report).

filters.description: Optional JSON ReportFilters to apply on top, e.g. {"period":{"preset":"last_month"}}.

merchant_id.description: Optional merchant to scope to. Admins and sub-merchant operators only; other callers always use their token's merchant.

name: run_report

columns.description: Each column: id, kind (dimension | measure), type, label, and for measures a format.

ok.description: false when this block could not run; see error. Other blocks are unaffected.

period.description: The period the block covered: from, to (inclusive), snapshot (true when the dataset ignores the period).

previous.description: compare previous_period: the same measures for the period before.

rows.description: One object per row, keyed by column id.

truncated.description: More rows exist than the block limit.

filters.description: The filters the blocks ran with (report defaults, then your saved filters, then the ones you passed).

title: Run custom report
